title: The same model, with the loved film already kept in the Vibe whose core they only liked
construction_note: docs/work/vibe-refit. m5-08's model, with Before Sunrise saved earlier as want-to-see and filed in Walk and Talk, with nothing said about it. A loved said now is kept at once — the film is filed — and says they watched it, so its viewing moves to seen-before in that turn. Walk and Talk is anchored on Before Sunset, which they only liked, and Before Sunrise embodies it wholly as its sentence stands: the kept path's one offer is Before Sunrise as its core, named against Before Sunset, which stays in it — and no new wording, since the sentence is true of both.

genres.name: Talky
genres.instruction: Films I watch for how people talk to each other; the plot can wait.

genres.name: Romance
genres.instruction: I like watching two people slowly fall for each other.

genres.name: Neo-Noir

genres.name: Synth Score

vibes.name: Walk and Talk
vibes.instruction: Two people, one long conversation as they walk, and nothing at stake but what they'll be to each other.

vibes.name: Neon and Silence
vibes.instruction: Los Angeles after dark, a man who barely speaks, and a synth score doing the talking.
